$comment: The ATC copilot's transmissions (the engine's atc_call and readback_check, radio/src/atc.rs), written for these tests: no recording or transcript of real ATC is in them. Each expected answer is a plain reading of the words against AIM 4-2-3 c (a pilot's call sign at either end), 4-2-4 (its forms), 4-4-7 b (readback), 5-3-8 (a hold's items) and 4-2-12 (UTC). Held by the engine's tests/atc.rs and the web's features/atc tests.

calls.heard: Cessna one two three alpha bravo, turn left heading two seven zero, descend and maintain three thousand, Chicago altimeter two niner niner two

calls.name: a hand-off and a code
calls.heard: November three alpha bravo, squawk four five one two, contact Chicago Approach one two five point three five

calls.name: a direct and a climb
calls.heard: November one two three alpha bravo proceed direct Gopher, climb and maintain seven thousand
